summary.text: Samuel Lenaeus is the Republican candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Inga Willis (D).

paragraphs.text: Samuel Lenaeus was born in Atlanta, Georgia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Atlanta native from a long line of Georgia families.
His listed campaign messages are preserving the uniqueness of neighborhoods, government of the people, and safety first, and he named the people's right to referendum as a policy interest.
